description: Daily Brief V2 handoff packet. Splits user-facing render_payload from internal governance_metadata so governance never renders into the brief body. V2 is a projection over the V1 packet (no new retrieval); sections without a current data source are emitted empty with honest data_gaps entries deferred to Prompt 02 (record-level enrichment).
global_requirements: render_payload carries user-facing, brief-ready data only.
governance_metadata is never rendered into the brief body.
no governance key (packet_id/hash, source coverage, guardrails, proof/receipt metadata) appears inside render_payload.
source refs are emitted as hashes + safe labels only (no raw refs, bodies, tokens, or URLs).
review-required, stale, and low-confidence flags are preserved on renderable items.
read-only; metadata-only; persists nothing; fail-closed on missing contract or raw leakage.
empty sections are honest data_gaps, not fabricated content; enrichment lands in Prompt 02.

cli.build: hb-assistant second-brain daily-brief packet --date YYYY-MM-DD --version v2 --json
